parent_tree: preserve exact 160000 gitlink entries and official commit OIDs
submodule_worktree: preserve complete initialized public contents and ignored build artifacts
submodule_git: reconstruct current commit and its tree/blob objects only; retain raw current commit identity and use a shallow boundary to exclude its parent history
nested_submodules: recursive reconstruction with the same boundary
candidate_semantics: a working-tree patch may modify files inside an initialized submodule without changing its recorded parent gitlink OID; never label a flattened encoding tree as the official parent tree
